snippet.title: Queen's Domain | Release Date & Console Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Queen's Domain is going to be releasing on Steam, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series on 30th October.

Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1799840/Queens_Domain/
